children: DeSantis Damon, a Director, purchased a total of 36,000 shares of Celsius Holdings common stock in transactions dated September 14–15, 2026. The reported prices per share are weighted averages of $27.65 for the 20,000-share purchase and $27.95 for the 16,000-share purchase. The total purchase amount reported is $1,000,200. Following these transactions, DeSantis Damon directly owns 2,728,187 shares.
